blocks.title: Collaboration
blocks.text: Collaboration is two or more people working together towards a common goal, sharing ideas, resources and effort.

Students work together on group projects and community members organize events together. For a science exhibition model, one student draws the diagrams, another builds the model and another explains it, producing a better project than any could alone (class activity).

blocks.prompt: Why is collaboration important in the entrepreneurial process (short question 8)?
blocks.explanation: No founder has every skill; partners, staff and advisers bring different strengths, ideas and resources, so problems are solved faster and the business is stronger.

items: Collaboration combines different strengths for a better result.
